metadata.label: Age of residential buildings by region Year 2010-2025
note: The table contains information about the age of residential buildings in age intervals based on data on year of construction in the Swedish National Real Property Register. Data is presented in absolute values and percent. Percentage refers to the share of the total number of residential buildings per region. Years of construction earlier than 1930 are uncertain and figures should be used with caution.
Due to quality improvement in the building register, data for all years have been revised.
